note SC1-R pure serial transitions. No authentication, locking, persistence or allocator.
note Fresh implementation; old AGPL action/delegate/reuse contracts read, not copied.
note State64: B[0:8], U[8:16], slot charges[16:32], slot metadata[32:56].
note Metadata12: id,phase,request,owner,grant,object,version,epoch, four zero words.
note Phase0 idle,1 reserved,2 uncertain,3 committed attributable used stock.
note Header56: next-id,spent-fuel,fuel-bound,request-highwater0/1,owner0/1,format1.
note Token8: slot,id,request,owner,grant,object,version,epoch. IDs/requests never wrap.
note Owners are fixed public partitions. Per-owner request sequence must strictly increase.
note Caller validates originals and trusted identities inside existing serialized writer.
note Zero return success; 1 invalid state/input,2 binding/replay,3 capacity,4 unknown.
note Arrays passed to one operation must not alias. Snapshot state is authoritative, not a client copy.
note Local subtraction guards implement SC1-Q boundary rule without struct provenance claims.

fn rv_meta slot ulong to ulong
ret add 32 mul slot 12
end
fn rv_charge slot ulong to ulong
ret add 16 mul slot 8
end
fn rv_phase s view ulong 64 slot ulong to ulong
ret get s add rv_meta slot 1
end
fn rv_valid s view ulong 64 to ulong
if ne get s 63 1
ret 1
end
if or eq get s 56 0 gt get s 57 get s 58
ret 1
end
if or eq get s 61 0 or eq get s 62 0 eq get s 61 get s 62
ret 1
end
for j ulong 2
m = rv_meta j
p = get s add m 1
if gt p 3
ret 1
end
for k ulong 4
if ne get s add m add 8 k 0
ret 1
end
end
if ne p 0
if or eq get s m 0 ge get s m get s 56
ret 1
end
if ne get s add m 3 get s add 61 j
ret 1
end
if ne get s add m 2 get s add 59 j
ret 1
end
for k ulong 6
if eq get s add m add 2 k 0
ret 1
end
end
else
for k ulong 12
if ne get s add m k 0
ret 1
end
end
end
end
if and ne rv_phase s 0 0 ne rv_phase s 1 0
if eq get s 32 get s 44
ret 1
end
end
for d ulong 8
left = get s d
used = get s add 8 d
if gt used left
ret 1
end
left = sub left used
for j ulong 2
q = get s add rv_charge j d
p = rv_phase s j
if eq p 0
if ne q 0
ret 1
end
end
if or eq p 1 eq p 2
if gt q left
ret 1
end
left = sub left q
end
if eq p 3
if gt q used
ret 1
end
used = sub used q
end
end
end
ret 0
end
fn rv_init s edit ulong 64 b view ulong 8 owners view ulong 2 fuel ulong to ulong
for i ulong 64
if ne get s i 0
ret 1
end
end
if eq get owners 0 0
ret 1
end
if eq get owners 1 0
ret 1
end
if eq get owners 0 get owners 1
ret 1
end
for i ulong 8
put s i get b i
end
put s 56 1
put s 58 fuel
put s 61 get owners 0
put s 62 get owners 1
put s 63 1
ret 0
end
fn rv_bind s view ulong 64 t view ulong 8 to ulong
if ne rv_valid s 0
ret 1
end
if gt get t 0 1
ret 2
end
m = rv_meta get t 0
if eq get s add m 1 0
ret 2
end
if ne get s m get t 1
ret 2
end
for i ulong 6
if ne get s add m add 2 i get t add 2 i
ret 2
end
end
ret 0
end
fn rv_room s view ulong 64 d ulong to ulong
left = sub get s d get s add 8 d
for j ulong 2
p = rv_phase s j
if or eq p 1 eq p 2
left = sub left get s add rv_charge j d
end
end
ret left
end
fn rv_reserve s edit ulong 64 t view ulong 8 q view ulong 8 fuel ulong to ulong
if ne rv_valid s 0
ret 1
end
if gt get t 0 1
ret 2
end
j = get t 0
if ne rv_phase s j 0
ret 2
end
if or ne get t 1 get s 56 eq get s 56 18446744073709551615
ret 2
end
if ne get t 3 get s add 61 j
ret 2
end
if le get t 2 get s add 59 j
ret 2
end
for i ulong 6
if eq get t add i 2 0
ret 2
end
end
if gt fuel sub get s 58 get s 57
ret 3
end
for d ulong 8
if gt get q d rv_room s d
ret 3
end
put s add rv_charge j d get q d
end
note Mutation begins only after all eight stocks and all bindings validate.
for d ulong 8
put s add rv_charge j d get q d
end
m = rv_meta j
put s m get t 1
put s add m 1 1
for i ulong 6
put s add m add 2 i get t add 2 i
end
put s add 59 j get t 2
put s 56 add get s 56 1
put s 57 add get s 57 fuel
ret 0
end
fn rv_uncertain s edit ulong 64 t view ulong 8 to ulong
r = rv_bind s t
if ne r 0
ret r
end
if eq rv_phase s get t 0 3
ret 4
end
put s add rv_meta get t 0 1 2
ret 4
end
fn rv_clear s edit ulong 64 slot ulong to void
for i ulong 8
put s add rv_charge slot i 0
end
for i ulong 12
put s add rv_meta slot i 0
end
end
note quiet and public are authoritative adapter facts, never client flags.
note No completion/cancel/error calls this until actual effects and public release permit.
fn rv_commit s edit ulong 64 t view ulong 8 actual view ulong 8 quiet bool public bool to ulong
r = rv_bind s t
if ne r 0
ret r
end
j = get t 0
if eq rv_phase s j 3
ret 2
end
if not and quiet public
ret 4
end
for d ulong 8
if gt get actual d get s add rv_charge j d
ret 3
end
end
for d ulong 8
put s add 8 d add get s add 8 d get actual d
put s add rv_charge j d get actual d
end
put s add rv_meta j 1 3
ret 0
end
note Internal apply helper requires rv_reclaim preflight; not an admission API.
fn rv_reclaimed s edit ulong 64 gone view ulong 8 j ulong to void
bits = ulong 0
for d ulong 8
q = sub get s add rv_charge j d get gone d
put s add rv_charge j d q
put s add 8 d sub get s add 8 d get gone d
bits = or bits q
end
if eq bits 0
rv_clear s j
end
end
note Reclaim vector denotes stock actually reclaimed with required durability.
note Stock is attributable to this slot; cannot release somebody else's used charge.
fn rv_reclaim s edit ulong 64 t view ulong 8 gone view ulong 8 durable bool public bool to ulong
r = rv_bind s t
if ne r 0
ret r
end
j = get t 0
if ne rv_phase s j 3
ret 2
end
if not and durable public
ret 4
end
for d ulong 8
if gt get gone d get s add rv_charge j d
ret 3
end
end
rv_reclaimed s gone j
ret 0
end
note Recovery raises used to max(ledger,observed), never discounts missing evidence.
note Caller supplies authoritative complete retained+temporary physical stock census.
note Reservations stay charged; inconsistent capacity leaves snapshot untouched and refuses admission.
fn rv_recover s edit ulong 64 actual view ulong 8 to ulong
if ne rv_valid s 0
ret 1
end
for d ulong 8
old = get s add 8 d
if gt get actual d old
if gt sub get actual d old rv_room s d
ret 3
end
end
end
for d ulong 8
if gt get actual d get s add 8 d
put s add 8 d get actual d
end
end
ret 0
end
